questions.question:
Study the following graph and answer the question that follows.

Number of students that appeared and qualified, from various colleges, at a scholarship examination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/615df86ad925d0aa74fb351dd344ba1189af61f4cd69c46e83a0825983e440e8.png] 

The average number of students that qualified in the examination from Colleges X and Y is what percentage of the average number of students that appeared for the examination from the same colleges?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Average number of students that qualified in the examination from Colleges X and Y = [1800 + 1600]/2 = 1700

Average number of students that appeared for the examination from Colleges X and Y = [3000 + 2000]/2 = 2500

⇒ Required % = 1700/2500 × 100 = 68%

A soft drink company prepares drinks of three different flavours A, B and C. The bar graph shows the production of three flavours over a period of five years from 2010 to 2014.

Production of three different flavours A. B and C by a company over the five years (in lakh bottles).

What percentage of the total production of soft drink of flavour A in 2013 and 2014 is the total production of soft drink of flavour B in 2011 and 2012?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Production of soft drink of flavour A in 2013 and 2014 is 45 and 75 resp.

Production of soft drink of flavour B in 2011 and 2012 is 40 and 50 resp.

**Calculation:**

Total production of soft drink of flavour A in 2013 and 2014 = 45 + 75 = 120

Total production of soft drink of flavour B in 2011 and 2012 = 40 + 50 = 90

∴ Required % = (90/120) × 100 = 75%

questions.question: In what time will a sum of Rs.1,25,000 amount to Rs.1,48,877 at 12% per annum, if interest is being compound half-yearly?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

P = Rs. 125000

Amount after interest compounded half yearly = Rs. 148877

Rate = 12%

**Formula used: **

For ‘t’ years, on C.I., Amount = Principal \times ( 1 + rate%/100 )t

When interest compounded half yearly, yearly Rate = 12%/2 = 6%, yearly time ‘t’ = 2 \times (half yearly time = T)

**Calculation:**

Putting values, we get, 148877 = 125000 \times ( 1 + 6/100 )t

⇒ 148877 / 125000 = ( 1 + 3/50 )t

⇒ ( 53/50 )³ = ( 53/50 )t

⇒ t = 3 i.e. 3 cycles of six months

∴ T = 3/2 years = 1.5 years

questions.question: A can complete one-sixth of a work in 5 days and B can complete one-fourth of the same work in 15 days. In how many days, will both working together complete the work?
questions.solution:
Given:

A can complete one-sixth of a work in 5 days and B can complete one-fourth of the same work in 15 days.

**Formula used:**

 If, A can complete a work in 't1' time and B can complete a work in 't2' time

then, A and B together can complete total work in ' t1 × t2 × 1/(t1 + t2) ' time

**Calculation:**

A can complete one-sixth of a work in 5 days

⇒ A can complete total work in 5 × 6 days = 30 days

B can complete one-fourth of the same work in 15 days

⇒ B can complete total work in 15 × 4 days = 60 days

∴ A and B together can complete total work in 30 × 60 × 1/(30 + 60) days = 30 × 60 × 1/90

= 20 days

questions.question: The difference between the two perpendicular sides of a right-angles triangle is 17 cm and its area is 84cm². What is the perimeter (in cm) of the triangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference between the two perpendicular sides of a right-angles triangle is 17 cm and its area is 84cm2

**Formula used:**

H² = P2 + B2

Area of right angled triangle = 1/2 × base × height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f66ac7587c77afc9184cc36707962db534841d4c9fd244988f5c824f5e0ac85d.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let one side of triangle = x cm ⇒ other perpendicular side = x - 17 (∵ difference between the two perpendicular sides of a right-angles triangle is 17 cm)

Area of right angled triangle = 1/2 × x × (17 - x) = 84

⇒ x² - 17x - 168 = 0

⇒ x2 - 24x + 7x - 168 = 0

⇒ x (x - 24) +7 (x - 24) = 0

⇒ (x +7) (x - 24) = 0

⇒ x = 24 (∵ side cannot be negative)

Thus, H² = (24)² + (7)2 = 625 = (25)2

∴ 3 sides of triangle are x = 24 cm, x - 17 = 7 cm and H = 25 cm

∴ Perimeter of triangle = 24 + 7 + 25 = 56 cm

questions.question: The average of 29 number is 38. The average of the first 19 numbers is 34 and that of the last 9 numbers is 48. The 20th number is.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 29 number is 38,

Average of the first 19 numbers is 34 and 

Average of the last 9 numbers is 48

**Formula used:**

Sum = Average × number 

**Calculation:**

Sum of all 29 numbers = Average × number = 38 × 29 = 1102

Sum of first 19 numbers = Average × number = 34 × 19 = 646

Sum of last 9 numbers = Average × number = 48 × 9 = 432

∴ 20th number = Sum of all 29 numbers - Sum of first 19 numbers - Sum of last 9 numbers

= 1102 - 646 - 432

= 24

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The average of 29 numbers is 38

The average of the first 19 numbers is 34, 

Which is (38 - 34) = 4 less than the total average,

So, the 19 numbers contribute 4 × 19 = 76 less 

Similarly, the average of the last 9 numbers is 48

Which is contributes (48 - 38) = 10 × 9 = 90 more

So, the net difference is (90 - 76) = 14

This extra 14 adjusted by 20th number, which is (38 - 14) = 24
